subject: Alpha 0.4 end-to-end proof of concept built and CI verified
body: Under explicit human direction, Manager-01 converted the existing BenefitFlow beta into Alpha 0.4, an end-to-end synthetic product demonstrator. The build now presents human-readable benefit/evidence cards, utilization planning, assertion-level provider provenance/freshness, synthetic provider verification, exact approval cards, irreversible scoped authorization, no raw proposal identifier persistence, bounded parser inputs, and a local idempotent transaction simulator with confirmed/waitlisted/retryable/rejected/reconciliation-required outcomes plus sanitized audit history. Commit 381240ebeb0dd30cef5d7ed8c2df159378b87f18 passed 51 BenefitFlow tests and 18 framework tests; recursive role parity and PRIMARY/MANAGER/RESEARCH package generation also passed, and the verified package artifact was uploaded. P0 remains active and live integrations remain blocked. Next product milestone is closed-pilot readiness, not live autonomous integration.
